titulo: Technology and the World We Live In
titulo_es: La tecnología y el mundo en que vivimos
estandares: Produzco textos informativos y expositivos sobre procesos tecnológicos. Explico causas, efectos y contrastes, y describo transformaciones a lo largo del tiempo.
competencias: Usar la voz pasiva en los tiempos principales; construir condicionales de tipo cero y uno; enlazar ideas con conectores de causa, efecto y contraste; describir cambios tecnológicos y sociales.
componentes: Pensamiento crítico, comunicación, colaboración y creatividad.

proyecto.descripcion_es: En grupos, los estudiantes comparan un ámbito de la vida (la música, la banca, la educación) antes y después de la digitalización, con un informe en voz pasiva y conectores de causa y efecto.
proyecto.descripcion_en: In groups, students compare one area of life (music, banking, education) before and after digitalization, in a report written with the passive voice and cause-and-effect connectors.

lecciones.content_es:
Cómo se forma

to be (en el tiempo correspondiente) + participio pasado.

Engineers design the system. (activa) → The system is designed by engineers. (pasiva)

Por qué se usa

  • El agente es desconocido o irrelevante: The data was deleted.
  • Interesa más el objeto que quien actúa: The vaccine was developed in 2020.
  • Registro impersonal en informes y textos científicos: The samples were analyzed.

El complemento agente

Se introduce con by y solo se pone si aporta información: designed by Turing. El instrumento se introduce con with: cut with a laser.

Requisito

Solo los verbos transitivos (con objeto directo) admiten pasiva. Arrive, happen y exist no la tienen.
lecciones.content_en:
How it is formed

to be (in the corresponding tense) + past participle.

Engineers design the system. (active) → The system is designed by engineers. (passive)

Why it is used

  • The agent is unknown or irrelevant: The data was deleted.
  • The object matters more than who acts: The vaccine was developed in 2020.
  • Impersonal register in reports and scientific texts: The samples were analyzed.

The agent

It is introduced with by and only stated when it adds information: designed by Turing. The instrument takes with: cut with a laser.

Requirement

Only transitive verbs (with a direct object) have a passive. Arrive, happen and exist do not.

lecciones.t: La pasiva en todos los tiempos
lecciones.content_es:
La tabla completa

  • Presente simple: is / are + participio — The data is stored.
  • Pasado simple: was / were — The system was updated.
  • Presente continuo: is / are being — The site is being redesigned.
  • Pasado continuo: was / were being — It was being tested.
  • Presente perfecto: has / have been — The files have been deleted.
  • Pasado perfecto: had been — It had been sent before noon.
  • Futuro: will be — The app will be launched in May.
  • Con modal: modal + be — It must be checked. / It can be improved.
  • Con modal perfecto: modal + have been — It could have been avoided.

Regla constante

Lo único que cambia es la forma de be; el participio nunca varía.

Ojo

No existe pasiva del futuro continuo ni del perfecto continuo en uso normal: se prefiere reformular en activa.
lecciones.content_en:
The full table

  • Present simple: is / are + participle — The data is stored.
  • Past simple: was / were — The system was updated.
  • Present continuous: is / are being — The site is being redesigned.
  • Past continuous: was / were being — It was being tested.
  • Present perfect: has / have been — The files have been deleted.
  • Past perfect: had been — It had been sent before noon.
  • Future: will be — The app will be launched in May.
  • With a modal: modal + be — It must be checked. / It can be improved.
  • With a perfect modal: modal + have been — It could have been avoided.

Constant rule

The only thing that changes is the form of be; the participle never varies.

Careful

There is no normal passive for the future continuous or the perfect continuous: rephrase in the active instead.

lecciones.t: Pasiva con dos objetos y estructuras impersonales
lecciones.t_en: Passive with two objects and impersonal structures
lecciones.content_es:
Verbos con dos objetos

Verbos como give, send, offer, tell, show, teach, pay tienen dos objetos y por eso admiten dos pasivas:

They gave the students a certificate.
→ The students were given a certificate. (la más natural)
→ A certificate was given to the students.

Estructuras impersonales

Muy usadas en noticias y textos académicos:

  • It is said that the system is safe.
  • The system is said to be safe.
  • It was reported that the data had been leaked.

Verbos frecuentes: say, believe, think, know, report, expect, consider, claim.

Ojo

La versión con It is said that… es la más sencilla de construir; la otra exige mover el sujeto y usar to + infinitivo.
lecciones.content_en:
Verbs with two objects

Verbs like give, send, offer, tell, show, teach, pay have two objects and therefore allow two passives:

They gave the students a certificate.
→ The students were given a certificate. (the more natural one)
→ A certificate was given to the students.

Impersonal structures

Very common in news and academic texts:

  • It is said that the system is safe.
  • The system is said to be safe.
  • It was reported that the data had been leaked.

Frequent verbs: say, believe, think, know, report, expect, consider, claim.

Careful

The It is said that… version is the easiest to build; the other requires moving the subject and using to + infinitive.

lecciones.t: Condicional cero y primero: hechos y predicciones
lecciones.t_en: Zero and first conditional: facts and predictions
lecciones.content_es:
Condicional cero: leyes y procesos

If + presente, presente. Ideal para explicar cómo funciona algo:

If you overload the circuit, the fuse burns out. · When data is encrypted, it becomes unreadable.

Primer condicional: consecuencias probables

If + presente, will + base:

If we adopt this system, we will save time.

Variantes del resultado

Modal (can, may, should), imperativo o be going to: If it fails, restart the server.

Otros conectores

unless, as long as, provided that, in case, even if, otherwise.

The update will run provided that the device is charged. · Back up your files; otherwise, you may lose them.

Regla

En la parte de la condición no va will nunca.
lecciones.content_en:
Zero conditional: laws and processes

If + present, present. Ideal for explaining how something works:

If you overload the circuit, the fuse burns out. · When data is encrypted, it becomes unreadable.

First conditional: likely consequences

If + present, will + base:

If we adopt this system, we will save time.

Result variants

A modal (can, may, should), an imperative or be going to: If it fails, restart the server.

Other connectors

unless, as long as, provided that, in case, even if, otherwise.

The update will run provided that the device is charged. · Back up your files; otherwise, you may lose them.

Rule

The condition half never takes will.

lecciones.t: Conectores de causa, efecto y contraste
lecciones.t_en: Connectors of cause, effect and contrast
lecciones.content_es:
Causa

  • because / since / as + oración: because the network failed
  • because of / due to / owing to + sustantivo: due to a power cut
  • The reason for … is that …

Efecto

  • so + oración (informal), therefore / thus / consequently / as a result (formal, con coma)
  • lead to / result in / bring about / cause + sustantivo o gerundio: Automation has led to job losses.

Contraste

  • although / even though / though + oración
  • despite / in spite of + sustantivo o gerundio
  • however / nevertheless / on the other hand abren oración, con coma
  • whereas / while comparan dos sujetos

Errores frecuentes

No se combinan although y but, ni because y so. Y despite nunca lleva of; in spite sí: in spite of.
lecciones.content_en:
Cause

  • because / since / as + clause: because the network failed
  • because of / due to / owing to + noun: due to a power cut
  • The reason for … is that …

Effect

  • so + clause (informal), therefore / thus / consequently / as a result (formal, with a comma)
  • lead to / result in / bring about / cause + noun or gerund: Automation has led to job losses.

Contrast

  • although / even though / though + clause
  • despite / in spite of + noun or gerund
  • however / nevertheless / on the other hand open a sentence, with a comma
  • whereas / while compare two subjects

Common mistakes

Do not combine although and but, nor because and so. And despite never takes of; in spite does: in spite of.

lecciones.content_es:
Innovación

innovation, breakthrough, prototype, patent, startup, scalability, disruption, upgrade, obsolete (obsoleto), state-of-the-art (de última generación).

Digitalización

digitalization, cloud computing, streaming, e-commerce, remote work, paperless, automation, encryption, open source, user experience.

Antes y después

People used to rent DVDs; now everything is streamed. · Payments were made in cash; today they are processed digitally.

Describir el cambio

shift (cambio de tendencia), transform, replace, adopt, phase out (retirar gradualmente), catch on, become widespread, go digital.

Ojo: actual significa real, no actual; se dice current.
lecciones.content_en:
Innovation

innovation, breakthrough, prototype, patent, startup, scalability, disruption, upgrade, obsolete, state-of-the-art.

Digitalization

digitalization, cloud computing, streaming, e-commerce, remote work, paperless, automation, encryption, open source, user experience.

Before and after

People used to rent DVDs; now everything is streamed. · Payments were made in cash; today they are processed digitally.

Describing change

shift, transform, replace, adopt, phase out, catch on, become widespread, go digital.

Careful: actual means real, not current.

lecciones.t: Fechas, números y caracteres en textos técnicos
lecciones.t_en: Dates, numbers and characters in technical texts
lecciones.content_es:
Números grandes y datos

1,500 → one thousand five hundred · 2.5 million · 75% seventy-five percent · 1/3 one third · 3:1 three to one.

En inglés la coma separa los miles y el punto marca los decimales, al revés del español: 1,250.75.

Fechas en informes

Formato internacional recomendado: 2026-03-15 o con el mes escrito: 15 March 2026.

Caracteres

# hash · @ at · _ underscore · / slash · \ backslash · & ampersand · * asterisk · % percent · + plus · = equals · < > angle brackets.

Describir cifras

Sales rose by 20%. · The figure fell to 3 million. · It doubled / tripled. · There was a sharp increase / a slight decline.

Ojo: rise by es cuánto subió; rise to es hasta dónde llegó.
lecciones.content_en:
Large numbers and data

1,500 → one thousand five hundred · 2.5 million · 75% seventy-five percent · 1/3 one third · 3:1 three to one.

In English the comma separates thousands and the period marks decimals: 1,250.75.

Dates in reports

Recommended international format: 2026-03-15 or with the month written out: 15 March 2026.

Characters

# hash · @ at · _ underscore · / slash · \ backslash · & ampersand · * asterisk · % percent · + plus · = equals · < > angle brackets.

Describing figures

Sales rose by 20%. · The figure fell to 3 million. · It doubled / tripled. · There was a sharp increase / a slight decline.

Careful: rise by is how much it went up; rise to is the level reached.

repaso.titulo: Repaso — Technology and the World We Live In
repaso.titulo_en: Review — Technology and the World We Live In
repaso.resumen_es:
Lo esencial del periodo

La voz pasiva es la herramienta del registro técnico: pone el foco en el proceso, no en quién lo hace. Se combina con los condicionales para explicar causas y consecuencias y con los conectores para articular el texto.

Puntos gramaticales

  • Pasiva = be (en el tiempo que sea) + participio. Solo cambia be.
  • by introduce el agente; with, el instrumento.
  • Con modales: modal + be + participio; modal perfecto: modal + have been + participio.
  • It is said that… y is said to be… son las estructuras impersonales.
  • despite + sustantivo, sin of; although + oración.

Vocabulario

Innovación y digitalización, verbos de cambio, formato de cifras y caracteres técnicos.
repaso.resumen_en:
The core of the term

The passive voice is the tool of technical register: it puts the focus on the process, not on who performs it. It combines with conditionals to explain causes and consequences and with connectors to articulate the text.

Grammar points

  • Passive = be (in any tense) + participle. Only be changes.
  • by introduces the agent; with, the instrument.
  • With modals: modal + be + participle; perfect modal: modal + have been + participle.
  • It is said that… and is said to be… are the impersonal structures.
  • despite + noun, with no of; although + clause.

Vocabulary

Innovation and digitalization, verbs of change, number formatting and technical characters.
